name: What are the benefits of repairing foggy windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing foggy windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing foggy windows offers several benefits beyond just aesthetics. A clear window improves visibility and allows more natural light into your home. More importantly, a compromised insulated glass unit (IGU) loses its energy efficiency. Repairing or replacing the sealed unit restores the window's insulating properties, which can lead to reduced energy consumption for heating and cooling. This can translate into savings on utility bills and a more comfortable indoor environment. It's also a more environmentally friendly option than full window replacement if only the glass unit is affected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing foggy windows restores clarity and natural light, improves energy efficiency by restoring insulation, and can reduce utility costs.
